columns.entityId: Stable entity/category identifier; not necessarily geographic
columns.name: Display name
columns.value: Source value or null; never treat null as zero
columns.status: observed, estimated, modelled, categorical or missing
columns.geographicId: ISO alpha-3 or explicitly defined region; null for abstract categories
columns.lat: Null unless a source validates exact point location
columns.lon: Null unless a source validates exact point location
columns.rank: Rank among the five named inventor locations, not among all inventions

geography.definition: Inventor location reported by WIPO; not filing office or owner.
geography.anchorRule: Use true country polygons for ISO-coded rows; use an abstract labelled ring for nongeographic rows. Never scatter aggregate values into cities or invent country intensity.

time.updateCadence: Manual reviewed refresh on source revision; never imply a live feed.

coverage.population: Simple patent families with inventors at each location; do not sum as uniquely owned worldwide inventions
coverage.omitted: All unlisted entities; this extraction is not necessarily exhaustive.
coverage.missingness: 0 null rows; unknown is not zero. No interpolation or imputation.

uncertainty: Source precision retained. No confidence interval is invented. Top five only, 2014–2023 historical window; no 2026 count claimed. Patent count does not measure practical rights to deploy an invention.
limitations: Top five only, 2014–2023 historical window; no 2026 count claimed.
Patent count does not measure practical rights to deploy an invention.

transform.description: Transcribe published factual values; preserve source grain and period.
transform.validation: Source-locator inspection and schema validation; independent review pending.

verification.method: Read primary sources and transcribe exact numbers/qualifiers.

scoring.reason: Show source values; no defensible universal 1–100 AI extremity score.

forecast.reason: No validated prediction model supplied. Do not extrapolate animation into a forecast.
